title: Checkout Refactor RC Plan
summary: Review the implementation plan before final approval.
freshSessionContext: A Laravel checkout flow needs a low-risk refactor. Preserve current API contracts and focused tests.

blocks.title: Implementation boundary
blocks.body: Move checkout calculation branching into a service while preserving request and response shape.

items.title: Keep contract stable
items.body: No frontend payload changes unless review feedback explicitly approves them.
items.impact: Avoids a paired frontend deploy for the first pass.

items.title: Feature coverage
items.body: Add success, validation, and edge-case assertions around the checkout endpoint.
items.impact: Proves behavior rather than internal service shape.
